scope: Train-only arithmetic-equality diagnostic; conditionally one validation configuration, never test
parser: Explicit '=' chains, complete numeric adjacent components, exact bounded rational AST; decimal RHS rounding tolerance; unknowns excluded, never reject candidates

diagnostic_gate_before_validation.manual_flagged_equation_audit: 20 deterministic seed17 randomly sampled flagged candidates, stratified by correct/incorrect final answer; at least 90% true arithmetic inconsistencies. Training-only parser bug fixes permitted and logged; never adapt to validation.

conditional_training.features: Original 1028 context features plus four arithmetic features
conditional_training.objective: Identical equal-per-question pairwise logistic objective to current best
conditional_training.selection: Fixed config complete validation and 355-question disagreement subset; keep previous best on tie or loss
conditional_training.error_analysis: At most 10 changed validation selections; no rule changes after validation

publication: Local code and report only; no submission or GitHub publication
